text:
ci-bot: :rotating_light: buildkite: pipeline *red* on main after merge (commit 6f2a1b3). Failed job: integration/gpu-kv-cache (step 12). Logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/9876#step-12

maria: saw the alert, not sure who merged last. @alex?

alex: that was me — merged PR #3421 ~18:10. I didn't run the full gpu integration suite locally, sorry. Looking now.

jen: can someone kick a rerun of just the failed job? sometimes infra transient.

opsbot: Requested: buildkite retry step 12 for build 9876 by jen — started.

opsbot: Retry finished — still failing.

dan: quick skim of the failing log shows an assertion in kv cache restore:
```
RuntimeError: KVCACHE_DESERIALIZE: mismatch at seq=0 expected 0x4a got 0x7f
  at runtime/cache/kv_cache.cpp:234
  stack: .../runtime/inference.cc:412
```

sanjay: that stack smells like the change in the sharded kv ordering from the PR. PR diff mentions a serialize_version bump in runtime/config.h. @alex did your change touch kv ordering or serialization?

alex: PR touched model sharding and a small serialize_version increment. I thought it was backwards-compatible but maybe not across cached prefixes. I can try a quick revert.

maria: before revert, would be great to bisect to confirm it's this PR and not a flake. If rerun failed, bisect is next. @infra can you warm up a pool of GPUs to avoid cold-start flakes during bisect?

infra: acknowledging — spinning up 4 warm VMs with preloaded images, ETA ~8m.

jen: bisect plan: git bisect start main 6f2a1b3~5 6f2a1b3 -- script to run integration/gpu-kv-cache. If someone can start local reproducer first:
```bash
# reproduce locally (docker-compose test harness)
./scripts/run_integration.sh --test kv_cache_integration --seed 42 --verbose
```

alex: starting bisect now on a dev box, will run the above reproducer against commits 6f2a1b3^..6f2a1b3 and post results. If bisect points to my PR, I'll open an urgent revert and a follow-up with a compatibility layer.

dan: thanks — if alex needs help I can assist with minimizing the reproducer. Might be a quick patch: add compatibility check in deserialize path to fall back to old ordering.

maria: adding label for oncall triage. @sanjay please review revert PR once posted. :eyes:

alex: update in ~20–30m. starting the bisect run (will ping when I have the offending commit).
